definition.legal_graph: Original valid_edge records (shared_edge_contact plus original legality), winding not added silently; opposed graph separate.
definition.unfiltered_graph: All actual indexed edges, including nonmanifold/illegal, for separating geometric split from legality split.
definition.vertex_graph: All actual shared vertex IDs, not proximity.
definition.single_face: Free faces alone in a legal edge component; C singleton excluded. No size threshold.
definition.area_fraction: All retained free face area denominator; C-connected in actual vertex graph but not legal edge graph numerator; NA if zero.
definition.bulk_edges: Legal exact-index two-face edges with both faces bulk; count depends on retained face budget, not semantic quality.

visual: PENDING_ACTUAL_REVIEW; these graphs do not prove floating or unsuitable semantic parts
